'''Haren Maseed''' was a powerful noble in the [[Free Years]].

==History==
Haren Maseed one of three powerful nobles who seized control of [[Tanchico]] during the [[War of the Hundred Years]] and founded the kingdom of [[Tarabon]] around it. He served as the first [[Panarch]] of Tarabon from {{Fy|1006}} onwards.
